n: 500 Series Gas Front Load Dryer - 8.0 Cu. Ft.
desc: The Electrolux front load gas dryer with LuxCare Dry uses an advanced moisture sensor to prevent over or under-drying. The Instant Refresh cycle allows you to remove wrinkles and refresh clothing in just 10 minutes.
hl: Normal Cycle Designed for Energy Efficiency
Our normal cycle was specifically created to use the least energy possible to get a full load dry, so normal use puts less burden on the planet.
Quickly dry the items you need most.
Takes care of delicate and expensive activewear garments.
Dry more in each load with our 8.0 Cu. Ft. dryers.
Fits more rooms with reversible door
Enjoy easy loading no matter how your washer and dryer are configured.
Extended Tumble option keeps clothes tangle-free
Gently tumbles your clothes without heat to keep them tangle-free--perfect for when you cannot remove clothes right after the cycle ends.
